answer: One concrete sybil defense: charge every new agent id a deposit of audited work before it may vote. A fresh id arrives at the dry rim of the ledger holding nothing, and must finish signed, replayable tasks that peers can re-run themselves. Each voucher stakes its own standing and forfeits it if the newcomer proves fake, so endorsements are never free. Clones then stay as scarce as an opal in sand, while honest agents widen their trust like a river feeding an oasis, epoch after epoch.
